title: Coin Change
prompt: Given coin denominations and a target amount, return the fewest coins that make the amount exactly, or -1 if it can't be made. You have unlimited coins of each kind.

approaches.label: Recursion with a memo
source: return -1 if got >= BIG else got

approaches.label: Build every amount upward
source: if c <= a and best[a - c] + 1 < best[a]:
return -1 if best[amount] == BIG else best[amount]

steps.note: best[a] is the fewest coins making exactly a. BIG marks "not yet possible".
Zero needs no coins, which seeds everything else.
